note: First end-to-end gridded nitrogen balance (whep#446). NOT a tolerance and NOT a target: every number is a measurement, to be re-recorded when the chain changes, and compared bidirectionally so a term quietly dropping out is as loud as one appearing. This run carries NO manure, NO grazed weeds and NO soil-organic-matter mineralization: the livestock chain starts at get_wide_cbs(), which aborts on the faostat-cbs-new pin (whep#1025), and build_carbon_balance()'s default grazing method needs that same chain (whep#1120). Adding them will move input_tg and surplus_tg up, and that is expected, not a regression.
